leadText:
Magikarpenter (Japanese: コイ・キンゲン Koi Kingen) is a character of the day who appeared in Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown!.

Magikarpenter competed in the tenth annual Magikarp High Jump Competition with his . He went up against Goh and his in the semifinals but ultimately lost to him.
